Add Ukrainian locale strings (if needed)\n- **File**: &#96;[locales.py](locales.py)&#96;\n- **Change**: Add strings for inline challenge if not already present\n- **Details**:\n  - Use existing &#96;JOIN_BTN = \"⚔️ До бою!\"&#96; or \"⚔️ Приєднатися\" (as used in group invites)\n  - Add: &#96;INLINE_CHALLENGE_TITLE = \"🎮 Створити виклик на гру\"&#96;\n  - Add: &#96;INLINE_CHALLENGE_DESC = \"Створіть виклик, до якого зможе приєднатися будь-хто\"&#96;\n  - Add: &#96;INLINE_CHALLENGE_MSG = \"🎮 &lt;b&gt;Виклик на гру в Шашки!&lt;/b&gt;\\n\\n{name} хоче зіграти!\\nНатисніть кнопку нижче, щоб приєднатися.\"&#96;\n\n### 2. Update &#96;inline_query_handler&#96; in &#96;handlers.py&#96;\n- **File**: &#96;[handlers.py](handlers.py)&#96; (lines 411-453)\n- **Change**: Replace the invitation code sharing result with a game challenge result in Ukrainian\n- **Details**:\n  - When query is empty or \"play\"/\"start\", show \"🎮 Створити виклик на гру\" option\n  - Description: \"Створіть виклик, до якого зможе приєднатися будь-хто\"\n  - Message text: Ukrainian challenge message with creator's name\n  - Include button \"⚔️ Приєднатися\" (Join) that triggers challenge acceptance\n  - Use &#96;ParseMode.HTML&#96; for formatting\n\n### 3. Implement &#96;chosen_inline_result_handler&#96; in &#96;handlers.py&#96;\n- **File**: &#96;[handlers.py](handlers.py)&#96; (lines 455-461)\n- **Change**: Implement challenge creation when inline result is selected\n- **Details**:\n  - When result_id is \"challenge\", create an inline challenge\n  - Store challenge data with: creator_id, creator_name, creator_username, inline_message_id, chat_id (from query), mode (default \"casual\")\n  - Use &#96;self.repo.save_inline_challenge(inline_message_id, challenge_data)&#96; to save\n  - Set appropriate TTL (repository handles this)\n\n### 4. Update join callback handler for inline challenges\n- **File**: &#96;[handlers.py](handlers.py)&#96; (lines 679-682 or create new handler)\n- **Change**: Handle join button clicks from inline challenges\n- **Details**:\n  - Check if callback is from an inline message (&#96;query.inline_message_id&#96;)\n  - Retrieve challenge data using &#96;self.repo.get_inline_challenge(inline_message_id)&#96;\n  - Validate challenge exists and is not expired\n  - Prevent creator from joining their own challenge\n  - Start a game between challenger and joiner using &#96;_start_game()&#96; method\n  - Set &#96;is_private_match=False&#96; for inline games (they're in the chat where challenge was sent)\n  - Update the inline message with the game board using &#96;_update_inline_game_message()&#96;\n  - Delete challenge after game starts\n\n## Implementation Details\n\n### Inline Query Handler Flow (Ukrainian)\n1. Challenge message appears in chat: \"🎮 Виклик на гру в Шашки! {name} хоче зіграти! Натисніть кнопку нижче, щоб приєднатися.\" with \"⚔️ Приєднатися\" button\n4.
